title: ROV Solution

dive: Choose a mode, vehicle and site, then deploy from the surface.
story: Join the YX crew: start in the pool, then take harbour and hull inspection jobs.
contracts: Take YX inspection, recovery and deployment contracts from the mission card at the top right after deploying.
training: Incident drills and scenarios ordered by difficulty.
multiplayer: Create or join a room. Up to three players share the same dive site.
collection: Photos, wildlife guide and engineering records.
settings: Realism, controls, audio, graphics and interface.

quickNone: Complete one dive to reuse your last settings with one click.

expedition: Explore, photograph wildlife and take contracts freely. Recovery and deployment require a manipulator.
free_explore: No timer or penalties. Practise piloting, manipulator use and marking.
inspection_coop: Split up across three stations, hold steady and take photos. Finish within 12 minutes.
scenario_training: Use each scenario's original objectives, time limit and scoring.

provisionalHelp: This vehicle has not been measured. Parameters are provisional estimates pending real measurements.
notForMode: This site is unavailable in this mode
noObjectives: Free cruising with no assigned objectives.
